subject.title: Discord plugin: channels added to channels.discord.guilds.*.channels.* post-startup are never subscribed (requires full gateway restart)

question: Should maintainers require a live Discord or focused integration reproduction before allowing a fix PR for this Discord add-channel hot-reload report?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 already show the generic Discord channel restart path, while the reporter describes a later real deployment where that path did not refresh inbound handling; choosing to repair now would require accepting source-only uncertainty.

options.title: Require live/focused repro
options.body: Keep this open with the existing no-new-fix-pr posture until a live Discord run or focused integration harness shows which reload step failed.

options.title: Queue source-level investigation
options.body: Allow an exploratory fix PR to add a regression harness around Discord channel config reload, stopping if the current path already passes.

options.title: Close as generic reload covered
options.body: Treat the existing Discord channel restart path as sufficient and close unless the reporter provides new logs, accepting the risk of missing the later deployment failure.

recommendation.title: Require live/focused repro
recommendation.body: Keep this open with the existing no-new-fix-pr posture until a live Discord run or focused integration harness shows which reload step failed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the clearest feature-history trail across the reload pipeline and Discord plugin-base boundaries that decide whether this needs gateway or plugin work.
